'''Pru Sweevant''' was a [[Narquois]] [[Gender|male]] who was [[Reproduction|born]] on the [[planet]] [[Narq]]<ref name="Datapad" /> in around [[21 BBY]].<ref name="Birth Date" /> He worked as a bandit around thirty [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor]]. Using contacts in the [[Mining Guild]], he learned the schedules of vulnerable convoys and raided them.<ref name="TFAVD" /> He took particular delight in capturing [[Starship|ships]] owned by [[Neimoidian]]s.<ref name="DB">{{Databank|pru-sweevant|Pru Sweevant}}</ref> He at one point served on the [[Sidon Ithano's pirate crew|crew]] of the [[pirate]] [[Sidon Ithano]]<ref name="VE" /> and was present in the [[Pirate Queen|pirate queen]] [[Maz Kanata]]'s [[Takodana Castle|castle]] when the [[smuggler]] [[Han Solo]] entered with the [[scavenger]] [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]], the former [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtrooper]] [[Finn]] and the [[astromech droid]] [[BB-8]]. Shortly after the four newcomers arrived, many of the patrons of the castle rushed outside to witness the [[Hosnian Cataclysm|destruction]] of the [[Hosnian system]] by [[Starkiller Base]], a [[superweapon]] controlled by the [[First Order]]. The castle itself was then [[Battle of Takodana|attacked]] and destroyed by the [[First Order military|First Order's forces]].<ref name="TFA">{{Film|VII}}</ref> While in the castle, Sweevant wore a [[Color|yellow]] [[Clothing|outfit]] and carried a [[blaster pistol]] with an amplified galven chamber that provided a more intense blast. He had red [[eye]]s and blue skin and [[hair]], which acted as camouflage amongst the [[fungus]] [[forest]]s of his [[homeworld]] [[Narq]].<ref name="TFAVD" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|C050 was a very simple head. But I designed it with the actor Kiran Shah in mind. It kind of looks like Kiran.|Ivan Manzella describes designing Sweevant|<ref name="Art">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Force Awakens]]''</ref>}}
Pru Sweevant was created for [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']], where he appeared briefly as a background character in Maz Kanata's castle.<ref name="TFA" /> The character was first revealed to the public through an exclusive [http://www.vanityfair.com/hollywood/2015/05/star-wars-force-awakens-photos article] on the website of [[Wikipedia:Vanity Fair|''Vanity Fair'']] in [[May]] [[2015]],<ref name="Vanity Fair">{{WebCite|url=http://www.vanityfair.com/hollywood/2015/05/star-wars-force-awakens-photos|text=Adam Driver and Lupita Nyong'o's Characters Revealed in Exclusive Star Wars: The Force Awakens Photos|author=Leibovitz, Annie|date=2015-05-04|work=[[Wikipedia:Vanity Fair (magazine)|Vanity Fair]]|archivedate=20150504170503}}</ref> seven months before the films release. Neither the article nor the film identified the character, but his name was revealed in the reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and released in conjunction with the film.<ref name="TFAVD" /> He was played by the actor [[Kiran Shah]], who also played [[Infrablue Zedbeddy Coggins]]<ref name="Kiran Shah">{{WebCite|url=https://www.littlekiran.com/wordpress/star-wars|text=Star Wars|work=[[Kiran Shah]]'s [https://www.littlekiran.com official website]|archivedate=20240907104954}}</ref> and [[Teedo]].<ref name="TFA" /> Senior sculptor [[Ivan Manzella]] designed Sweevant during pre-production of the film in [[October]] [[2013]], at which time he was known as "Castle Alien C050". Manzella designed the character's simple head with Shah specifically in mind, and believed the character and actor look somewhat alike.<ref name="Art" />
